# kiss-principle

Apply the KISS principle to reduce unnecessary complexity. Use ONLY when the user explicitly mentions "KISS", "simplify", "over-engineered", "too complex", or asks to review code/design specifically for unnecessary complexity. Do NOT trigger for general coding tasks, feature work, or architecture discussions unless simplicity is the named concern.

- **Entry point:** [SKILL.md](SKILL.md)
- **Version:** 2.0
- **Licence:** Apache-2.0, see [LICENSE](LICENSE)

## Install

Copy this directory into either skills location, then start a new session:

```bash
cp -r kiss-principle ~/.claude/skills/       # personal, all projects
cp -r kiss-principle .claude/skills/         # this project only
```

For Claude Desktop, zip the directory and upload it under
Settings, Capabilities, Skills. Released builds attach a ready-made zip.

## Bundled files

Loaded on demand, not up front. SKILL.md routes to them.

- `resources/complexity-analysis.md`
- `resources/decision-frameworks.md`
- `resources/simplification-strategies.md`
